responsibility: Top-level BRIG-to-GCC translation engine. This file implements the `brig_to_generic` driver class that locates BRIG sections, performs the initial analysis pass, dispatches code/data entries to the appropriate handlers during parsing, maintains module-wide symbol and segment state, fixes declaration-call edges, finalizes translated functions and kernels, emits kernel launchers and PHSA metadata, wraps up global declarations, and provides shared helper routines for builtin calls, type reinterpretation, visibility, and dumping.
same_name_distinction: Implements the module-level BRIG translation driver declared in brig-to-generic.h, including section discovery, analysis/parsing flow, global/finalization handling, and helper routines that coordinate handlers and finished functions.
